context: A uni student gives a teen friend honest career advice
purpose: Teach: 外見/プライド/資質/モラル/狩り/シンボル/青空/マスク

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、進路で悩んでて。私、人気者になりたいから芸能界目指そうかなって。
lines.en: Senpai, I'm stuck on my career path. I want to be popular, so maybe the entertainment industry?
lines.style: Hesitant teen voice seeking guidance from an older mentor

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正直に言うけど、外見だけで判断される世界だぞ。本当にそれでいいの?
lines.en: I'll be honest, it's a world where you're judged purely on looks. Are you really okay with that?
lines.style: Direct candid tone, gentle but firm older brother energy

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うーん、でも普通の仕事ってつまらなそうだし、私プライドが高いから下っ端は嫌で。
lines.en: Hmm, but ordinary jobs sound boring, and I have too much pride to start at the bottom.
lines.style: Defensive teen pushback with a hint of stubbornness

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そのプライド、武器にもなるけど、間違えると邪魔になる。リーダーの資質ってのは謙虚さからくるんだよ。
lines.en: That pride can be a weapon, but misdirected it becomes a hindrance. Leadership qualities come from humility.
lines.style: Calm reasoned mentor voice offering perspective without lecturing

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ、何を基準に選べばいいの?お金?やりがい?
lines.en: Then what should I use as a criterion to choose? Money? Fulfillment?
lines.style: Curious teen genuinely opening up to the advice

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: モラルの問題かな。自分が誇れる仕事か。芸能界も悪くないけど、青空の下で堂々と歩ける選択をしてほしい。
lines.en: It's a question of morals. Work you can be proud of. Entertainment isn't bad, but choose something you can walk under an open sky with your head high.
lines.style: Reflective sincere advice with poetic touch from older student

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なんか、就活の本に書いてある言葉みたい。先輩、最近インスタの「いいね狩り」してたくせに。
lines.en: That sounds like something from a job-hunting book. Senpai, you were just hunting for Instagram likes recently though.
lines.style: Playful teasing teen breaking the serious mood with humor

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うるさいな(笑)。でもさ、SNSのアイコンも自分のシンボルだろ?マスクをつけて演じる人生じゃなくて、素の顔で勝負しなよ。
lines.en: Hey, quiet (laughs). But hey, even your social media icon is your own symbol, right? Don't live a life wearing a mask, fight with your real face.
lines.style: Warm laughing comeback turning the joke back into sincere advice
